evidence: Frozen task.toml sha256 ac664d0eda969418119945e4b153c18a13e26d3e8bbc0a0f6907978c9e068f26 equals manifest.json /inputs/task/task.toml. Name: task.toml [task] name = "turing/hireops-recruiting-operations"; manifest task path projects/hireops-recruiting-operations/hireops-recruiting-operations -> dirname hireops-recruiting-operations, so name == turing/<dirname> as quality-checks.md #8 requires (snapshot dir 'task' is not a defect per assignment). Slug has 3 hyphen tokens, consistent with check-task-slug.sh (<=3). Org 'turing' per SKILL delivery profile. Description: "Recruiting workspace with a shared pipeline board and recruiter-candidate conversations that stay correct and usable while several people work at once." matches instruction.md lines 1-9 (pipeline board per job, conversation per application, several people at once) and app_context.md (Name: HireOps; Board, Conversations, Activity). No criterion counts are quoted in description/provenance, so the contract's count-reconciliation has nothing to contradict. Keywords [recruiting, pipeline, messaging, realtime, webdev, turing, full-stack] keep the template's fixed tail and each task word maps to the brief (realtime = instruction.md line 5 / rules section 5 15-second updates). Metadata: difficulty="hard" (allowed medium|hard); category="programming" and tags unchanged from contract; arena_slice="recruiting-hiring-operations" fits; provenance "Adapted from the supplied HireOps task as a recruiting workspace, with an authored reference implementation and browser rubric" is consistent. difficulty_explanation claims checked against hireops_rules.md and criteria: one-step moves (rules 3 'Moving a card', hro_move_one_stage), interview capacity (hro_interview_full), role rules (hro_mgr_*), stale moves refused and explained with who (rules 'Two people at once', hro_stale_refused), bulk all-or-nothing (hro_bulk_all_or_none), undo only while untouched (hro_undo_conflict), per-person unread/seen (hro_unread_counts, rules 6 Seen), paged history keeping place (hro_thread_earlier, hro_pol_earlier_place), drafts surviving reloads and ended sessions (hro_drafts, hro_pol_session_resume), live updates not disturbing typing/focus/scroll (hro_live_board, hro_pol_live_*), candidates never get staff-only data (hro_candidate_private). No stale references to removed features: grep for 'change desk/change-set' across frozen task md/toml/js/html found nothing, so the removed change-sets files left no identity residue. All template CHANGE_ME placeholders replaced. Adversarial check: this row grades metadata, not app behavior, so a broken app or conforming alternative cannot change its outcome; I looked instead for a description/explanation claim with no brief or criterion basis (would mislead) and found none. Minor Note (not a defect): staged-task-contract.md's template comment says description covers 'product, axes of difficulty, judge, dimension policy'; the description omits judge and dimension policy. The workbook row and quality-checks.md #8 only require that it names the product and actual axes, which it does; [verifier.env] and scoring.toml carry judge/weights. Not a score-affecting identity incoherence.
